properties.name: kitu.kotoutumiskoulutus.koealusta.keskeneraiset.enrolmentWindow
properties.description: How far back incomplete suoritukset are fetched from Koealusta, compared against course enrolment time (kotlin.time.Duration, e.g. 14d). Blank sends no limit. Doubles as the retention time of incomplete rows, because each run replaces the whole set.

properties.name: kitu.koski.username
properties.description: Username of service user used to send data to KOSKI.

properties.name: kitu.koski.password
properties.description: Password of service user used to send data to KOSKI.

properties.name: otel.resource.providers.aws.enabled
properties.description: Enables the AWS Resource Provides for Open Telemetry.
